minor.issue: For OHIP register the health_card is normalized but the phone field is stored as raw digits (e.g. '4165550100') instead of being normalized via identity_mod.normalize_phone. The portal Account UI then displays the raw string until the patient hits Edit + Save. Suggest calling normalize_phone on body.phone at registration for parity with /portal/profile/phone and internal PATCH.

issues: After clicking Approve the current-snapshot card doesn't auto-refresh; user must re-search to see updated HC. A silent refetch of the selected snapshot after hc-approve/hc-reject would remove the double-search step.

Numeric query '5006' surfaces 4 matches (PIN 5006 correctly first, plus 3 FORMER_CLOSED patients whose date-of-birth substrings contain '5006' or similar). Fine but consider tightening to exact PIN match for 4-digit numeric queries.

action_items: (Minor) Normalize `phone` in POST /api/auth/register the same way /portal/profile/phone does, so newly-registered OHIP patients see '(416) 555-0100' in the portal immediately instead of the raw '4165550100'.
(UX polish) After Approve/Reject in internal Patients HC pending panel, refetch the selected patient snapshot so the display updates without a manual re-search.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 2692 lines — the earlier recommendation to split into routers (auth/register, portal, internal patients, calendar) still stands; the Health Card + PIN rework adds three more endpoints (portal phone, portal HC, internal PATCH, HC approve/reject) inside the same monolith.

identity_mod.assign_visita_pin returns None only when 1000-9999 is exhausted — good; caller returns 507. Consider persisting a small metrics counter for near-exhaustion (e.g. warn at >90% used) so ops can plan for id-space expansion.

InternalPatientEditBody accepts visita_patient_id but does not validate it's a 4-digit numeric string. A staff typo like 'ABCD' would be accepted (no clash) and stored — recommend enforcing `^\d{4}$` (or reusing the same rules as auto-assignment) before persisting.

PortalAccount.jsx: no local validation of the pending Health Card issue/expiry dates before POST (backend correctly 400s, but a client-side check would be nicer). The current-verified card block also shows 'Health Card information incomplete.' when only expiry is missing, which is correct but does NOT block portal access (spec-compliant).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_health_card_pin.py is now the regression for this rework. Run with: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_health_card_pin.py -v -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini forces xdist load-scope; the -o override disables it). Note that /api/internal/patient-lookup filters to verification_status='verified' — to fetch a just-registered pending patient's id, hit MongoDB via users.patient_id (helper _pid_by_email in the test file). Register endpoint currently stores phone as raw digits (see minor issue).
rca of the issue: No blocking bug found. The single minor gap is that POST /api/auth/register does not call normalize_phone on body.phone, so an OHIP patient who typed '4165550100' will see the raw string in /portal/account until they Edit + Save (which routes through /portal/profile/phone -> normalize_phone -> '(416) 555-0100'). Two-line fix in server.py register() before insert: `phone = identity_mod.normalize_phone(body.phone)` and then `"phone": phone,` in the patient doc.
